subject: phy
title: Laws of Motion
syllabus: Force and inertia, Newton's First law of motion; Momentum, Newton's Second Law of motion, Impulses; Newton's Third Law of motion. Law of conservation of linear momentum and its applications. Equilibrium of concurrent forces. Static and Kinetic friction, laws of friction, rolling friction. Dynamics of uniform circular motion: centripetal force and its applications: vehicle on a level circular road, vehicle on a banked road.

body: 1st: no net force → no change in velocity (inertia). 2nd: F⃗ = \f{dp⃗}{dt} = ma⃗. 3rd: action and reaction are equal, opposite and act on DIFFERENT bodies.
Impulse J = FΔt = Δp = area under the F–t graph
Catching a ball: F = \f{mv}{t} — pulling the hands back raises t and lowers F.
Lift: apparent weight N = m(g + a) going up with acceleration a, m(g − a) going down; free fall → 0.

check.why: They can never cancel each other.

body: Draw each body alone, add every force on it (weight, normal, tension, friction, applied), choose axes, write ΣF = ma.
Blocks pulled in a line: a = \f{F}{Σm}; a string's tension = (mass behind it) × a.
Equilibrium with two strings: resolve horizontally and vertically (or use Lami's theorem). Movable pulley: the hanging block moves half as far.

body: Static friction adjusts up to μ_{s}N; kinetic friction = μ_{k}N (μ_{k} < μ_{s}). Independent of contact area.
Angle of repose: μ_{s} = tanθ. Sliding down: a = g(sinθ − μ cosθ). Pushing up at steady speed: F = mg(sinθ + μ cosθ).
Pulling at angle θ (steady): F = \f{μmg}{cosθ + μ sinθ} — lifting a little reduces N and friction.
Rough vs smooth incline time ratio n → μ = tanθ(1 − \f{1}{n^{2}}).

body: Centripetal force is not a new force — it is the net inward force (tension, friction, normal, gravity).
Flat road: v_{max} = √{μrg}. Banked: v^{2} = rg\f{μ + tanθ}{1 − μ tanθ} (μ = 0 → v^{2} = rg tanθ)
Vertical circle on a string: v_{top} ≥ √{gr}, v_{bottom} ≥ √{5gr}; then T_{bottom} − T_{top} = 6mg.
Coin on a turntable: ω_{max} = √{μg/r}. Rotor wall: μ_{min} = \f{g}{ω^{2}r}.

traps: Action–reaction pairs never cancel: they act on different bodies.
Normal force is not always mg (inclines, lifts, angled pulls).
Static friction is "up to" μN, not always μN.
At maximum banked speed friction acts DOWN the slope; at minimum speed, UP.
In a lift going up at constant speed the reading is just mg.
A movable pulley halves the motion of the hanging block.

pyq.q: A cricket player catches a ball of mass 120 g moving with 25 m/s speed. If the catching process is completed in 0.1 s then the magnitude of force exerted by the ball on the hand of player will be (in SI unit):
A body of mass 4 kg experiences two forces F⃗_{1} = 5î + 8ĵ + 7k̂ and F⃗_{2} = 3î − 4ĵ − 3k̂. The acceleration acting on the body is :

Two forces F_{1} and F_{2} are acting on a body. One force has magnitude thrice that of the other force and the resultant of the two forces is equal to the force of larger magnitude. The angle between F_{1} and F_{2} is cos^{−1}(\f{1}{n}). The value of |n| is ____.
A particle moves in x − y plane under the influence of a force F⃗ such that its linear momentum is P⃗(t) = î cos(kt) − ĵ sin(kt). If k is constant, the angle between F⃗ and P⃗ will be :
sol: F = \f{dP}{dt} = −k sin(kt) î − k cos(kt) ĵ.
P · F = −k sin cos + k sin cos = 0 → 90°.

pyq.q: A wooden block of mass 5 kg rests on soft horizontal floor. When an iron cylinder of mass 25 kg is placed on the top of the block, the floor yields and the block and the cylinder together go down with an acceleration of 0.1 m s^{−2}. The action force of the system on the floor is equal to:
sol: mg − N = ma → N = 30(9.8 − 0.1) = 291 N (the floor pushes 291 N, and by Newton's 3rd law the system pushes the floor with 291 N).

pyq.q: A body moves on a frictionless plane starting from rest. If S_{n} is distance moved between t = n − 1 and t = n and S_{n−1} is distance moved between t = n − 2 and t = n − 1, then the ratio \f{S_{n−1}}{S_{n}} is (1 − \f{2}{x}) for n = 10. The value of x is ____.
sol: From rest with constant a: S_{n} ∝ (2n − 1).

pyq.q: An object with mass 500 g moves along x-axis with speed v = 4√{x} m/s. The force acting on the object is :

A body of mass 2 kg moving with velocity of v⃗_{in} = 3î + 4ĵ m s^{−1} enters into a constant force field of 6 N directed along positive z-axis. If the body remains in the field for a period of \f{5}{3} seconds, then velocity of the body when it emerges from force field is.
sol: a = 3 m s^{−2} along z only: v_{z} = 3 × \f{5}{3} = 5; x and y parts unchanged → 3î + 4ĵ + 5k̂.

pyq.q: A player caught a cricket ball of mass 150 g moving at a speed of 20 m/s. If the catching process is completed in 0.1 s, the magnitude of force exerted by the ball on the hand of the player is:

The position of an object having mass 0.1 kg as a function of time t is given as r⃗ = (10t^{2}î + 5t^{3}ĵ) m. At t = 1 s, which of the following statements are correct? A. The linear momentum p⃗ = (2î + 1.5ĵ) kg m/s. B. The force acting on the object F⃗ = (2î + 3ĵ) N. C. The angular momentum of the object about its origin L⃗ = 15 k̂. D. The torque acting on the object about its origin τ⃗ = 20 k̂ N m. Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
A 4 kg mass moves under the influence of a force F⃗ = (4t^{3}î − 3tĵ) N where t is the time in second. If mass starts from origin at t = 0, the velocity and position after t = 2 s will be :
A spherical ball of mass 2 kg falls from a height of 10 m and is brought to rest after penetrating 10 cm into sand. The average force exerted by sand on the ball is ____ N. (Take g = 10 m/s^{2})
sol: Work–energy over the whole fall: mg(10 + 0.1) = F × 0.1.

pyq.q: At t = 0, a body of mass 100 g starts moving under the influence of a force (5î + 10ĵ) N from the origin. After 2 s its position is (2xî + 5yĵ) m. The ratio x : y is ____ .

A block of mass 25 kg is pulled along a horizontal surface by a force at an angle 45° with the horizontal. The friction coefficient between the block and the surface is 0.25. The block travels at a uniform velocity. The workdone by the applied force during a displacement of 5 m of the block is :
A 2 kg brick begins to slide over a surface which is inclined at an angle of 45° with respect to horizontal axis. The co-efficient of static friction between their surfaces is :
sol: Sliding just begins at the angle of repose: μ_{s} = tan45° = 1.

pyq.q: A heavy box of mass 50 kg is moving on a horizontal surface. If co-efficient of kinetic friction between the box and horizontal surface is 0.3 then force of kinetic friction is :
A cubic block of mass m is sliding down on an inclined plane at 60° with an acceleration of \f{g}{2}, the value of coefficient of kinetic friction is

A 5 kg block is simply released from the top of a frictionless 10 m long incline at 30°. At the bottom it moves 2 m on a rough horizontal surface (μ = 0.5) and then hits a spring of k = 100 N/m (the region at the spring is frictionless). The maximum compression in the spring when the block hits the spring is :
sol: Energy: mgh = 5 × 10 × 5 = 250 J; friction takes 0.5 × 50 × 2 = 50 J.

pyq.q: A given object takes n times the time to slide down 45° rough inclined plane as it takes the time to slide down an identical perfectly smooth 45° inclined plane. The coefficient of kinetic friction between the object and the surface of inclined plane is :

Given below are two statements : Statement (I) : The limiting force of static friction depends on the area of contact and independent of materials. Statement (II) : The limiting force of kinetic friction is independent of the area of contact and depends on materials. In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
sol: Friction (static or kinetic) = μN: independent of contact area, but μ depends on the two materials.
I is the reverse of the truth; II is right.
o: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct

pyq.q: The time taken by a block of mass m to slide down from the highest point to the lowest point on a rough inclined plane is 50% more compared to the time taken by the same block on identical inclined smooth plane. Both inclined planes are at 45° with the horizontal. The coefficient of kinetic friction between the rough inclined surface and block is ____.

A block of mass 1 kg is pushed up a surface inclined to horizontal at an angle of 60° by a force of 10 N parallel to the inclined surface. The coefficient of friction between block and incline is 0.1. When the block is pushed up by 10 m along inclined surface, the work done against frictional force is : [g = 10 m/s^{2}]

A block of mass m is placed on a surface having vertical cross section given by y = \f{x^{2}}{4}. If coefficient of friction is 0.5, the maximum height above the ground at which block can be placed without slipping is:
sol: Limit: slope = tanθ = μ → \f{dy}{dx} = \f{x}{2} = 0.5 → x = 1 m.

pyq.q: In the given arrangement of a doubly inclined plane two blocks of masses M and m are placed (M on the 53° face, m on the 37° face, joined by a string over the top pulley). The coefficient of friction between the surface of the plane and the blocks is 0.25. The value of m, for which M = 10 kg will move down with an acceleration of 2 m/s^{2}, is : (take g = 10 m/s^{2} and tan 37° = 3/4)
sol: M: Mg sin53° − μMg cos53° − T = Ma → 80 − 15 − T = 20 → T = 45 N.
m (moving up): T − mg sin37° − μmg cos37° = ma → 45 = m(6 + 2 + 2) → m = 4.5 kg.

pyq.q: A mass of 1 kg is kept on a inclined plane with 30° inclination with respect to horizontal plane and it is at rest initially. Then the whole assembly is moved up with constant velocity of 4 m/s. The work done by the frictional force in time 2 s is ____ J. (Take g = 10 m/s^{2})
sol: At rest on the incline: f = mg sin30° = 5 N, along the incline (upward), i.e. at 60° to the vertical.
Displacement 8 m straight up: W = 5 × 8 × cos60° = 20 J.

pyq.q: Consider a block and trolley system: a 20 kg trolley on a horizontal surface is tied by a string over a pulley to a hanging 6 kg block (weight 60 N). If the coefficient of kinetic friction between the trolley and the surface is 0.04, the acceleration of the system in m s^{−2} is : (Consider that the string is massless and unstretchable and the pulley is also massless and frictionless):

A body of mass 1 kg is suspended with the help of two strings: T_{1} makes 60° and T_{2} makes 30° with the horizontal ceiling. Magnitudes of tensions T_{1} and T_{2}, respectively, are (in N) : (Take acceleration due to gravity 10 m/s^{2})
sol: Horizontal: T_{1}cos60° = T_{2}cos30° → T_{1} = √{3}T_{2}. Vertical: T_{1}sin60° + T_{2}sin30° = 10.

pyq.q: A body of mass m is suspended by two strings making angles θ_{1} and θ_{2} with the horizontal ceiling with tensions T_{1} and T_{2} simultaneously. T_{1} and T_{2} are related by T_{1} = √{3}T_{2}, the angles θ_{1} and θ_{2} are

Three blocks M_{1}, M_{2}, M_{3} having masses 4 kg, 6 kg and 10 kg respectively are hanging from a smooth pully using rope 1, 2 and 3 (rope 1 above M_{1}, M_{2} below M_{1}, M_{3} lowest). The tension in the rope 1, T_{1} when they are moving upward with acceleration of 2 m s^{−2} is ____ N (if g = 10 m/s^{2})
sol: Rope 1 holds all three: T_{1} − 20g = 20a → T_{1} = 20 × 12 = 240 N.

pyq.q: A body of weight 200 N is suspended form a tree branch thought a chain of mass 10 kg. The branch pulls the chain by a force equal to (if g = 10 m/s^{2}):
sol: Chain + body in equilibrium: branch force = 200 + 100 = 300 N.

pyq.q: A light string passing over a smooth light pulley connects two blocks of masses m_{1} and m_{2} (where m_{2} > m_{1}). If the acceleration of the system is \f{g}{√{2}}, then the ratio of the masses \f{m_{1}}{m_{2}} is :

A 1 kg mass is suspended from the ceiling by a rope of length 4 m. A horizontal force 'F' is applied at the mid point of the rope so that the rope makes an angle of 45° with respect to the vertical axis. The magnitude of F is :
sol: At the midpoint: lower rope pulls down with mg = 10 N, F pulls sideways, upper rope at 45° balances both.

pyq.q: A light unstretchable string passing over a smooth light pulley connects two blocks of masses m_{1} and m_{2}. If the acceleration of the system is \f{g}{8}, then the ratio of the masses \f{m_{2}}{m_{1}} is:

Two blocks of masses 2 kg and 1 kg respectively, are tied to the ends of a string which passes over a light frictionless pulley. The masses are held at rest at the same horizontal level and then released. The distance traversed by the centre of mass in 2 s is ____ m. (Take g = 10 m/s^{2})

All surfaces shown in figure are assumed to be frictionless and the pulleys and the string are light. A 2 kg block on a 30° incline is tied by a string that runs over a fixed pulley and down to a movable pulley carrying a 4 kg block (string fixed to the ceiling on the other side). The acceleration of the block of mass 2 kg is :
sol: Constraint: the 2 kg block moves twice as far as the 4 kg block (a_{1} = 2a_{2}).

pyq.q: Three blocks A (5 kg), B (3 kg) and C (2 kg) are pulled on a horizontal smooth surface by a force of 80 N applied on C (strings T_{1} between A and B, T_{2} between B and C). The tensions T_{1} and T_{2} in the string are respectively:
A light string passing over a smooth light fixed pulley connects two blocks of masses m_{1} and m_{2}. If the acceleration of the system is g/8, then the ratio of masses is

Three masses m_{1} = 4 kg, m_{2} = 4 kg and m_{3} = 6 kg are suspended from a fixed smooth frictionless pulley: m_{1} hangs on one side (string tension T_{1}); m_{2} hangs on the other side (tension T_{1}) with m_{3} hanging below m_{2} by a string of tension T_{2}. The value of T_{1}/T_{2} is ____ (take g = 10 m/s^{2})

A small block of mass m slides down from the top of a frictionless inclined surface (angle θ, base length L), while the inclined plane is moving towards left with constant acceleration a_{0}. Assuming that initially the small block is at the top of the inclined plane, the time it takes to reach the lowest point of the inclined plane is ____
sol: In the wedge frame a pseudo-force ma_{0} acts to the right, i.e. partly UP the slope: a_{rel} = g sinθ − a_{0}cosθ.
Slope length \f{L}{cosθ}: t = √{\f{2L}{cosθ(g sinθ − a_{0}cosθ)}} = √{\f{4L}{g sin2θ − a_{0}(1 + cos2θ)}}.

pyq.q: A ball of mass 0.5 kg is attached to a string of length 50 cm. The ball is rotated on a horizontal circular path about its vertical axis. The maximum tension that the string can bear is 400 N. The maximum possible value of angular velocity of the ball in rad/s is:

A car of 800 kg is taking turn on a banked road of radius 300 m and angle of banking 30°. If coefficient of static friction is 0.2 then the maximum speed with which car can negotiate the turn safely : (g = 10 m/s^{2}, √{3} = 1.73)

A circular table is rotating with an angular velocity of ω rad/s about its axis. There is a smooth groove along a radial direction on the table. A steel ball is gently placed at a distance of 1 m on the groove. All the surface are smooth. If the radius of the table is 3 m, the radial velocity of the ball w.r.t. the table at the time ball leaves the table is x√{2}ω m/s, where the value of x is.
sol: In the rotating frame only the centrifugal force acts along the groove: r̈ = ω^{2}r.

pyq.q: A 0.5 kg mass is in contact against the inner wall of a cylindrical drum of radius 4 m rotating about its vertical axis. The minimum rotational speed of the drum to enable the mass to remain stuck to the wall (without falling) is 5 rad/s. The coefficient of friction between the drum's inner wall surface and mass is ____ . (Take g = 10 m/s^{2})
sol: Wall pushes inward N = mω^{2}r; friction μN must hold mg.

pyq.q: A car of mass 'm' moves on a banked road having radius 'r' and banking angle θ. To avoid slipping from banked road, the maximum permissible speed of the car is v_{0}. The coefficient of friction μ between the wheels of the car and the banked road is
sol: At v_{max}, friction acts down the slope: v_{0}^{2} = rg\f{μ + tanθ}{1 − μ tanθ}.
Solve for μ: μ = \f{v_{0}^{2} − rg tanθ}{rg + v_{0}^{2}tanθ}.

pyq.q: A stone of mass 900 g is tied to a string and moved in a vertical circle of radius 1 m making 10 rpm. The tension in the string, when the stone is at the lowest point is (if π^{2} = 9.8 and g = 9.8 m/s^{2})

A body of mass 'm' connected to a massless and unstretchable string goes in vertical circle of radius 'R' under gravity g. The other end of the string is fixed at the center of circle. If velocity at top of circular path is n√{gR}, where, n ≥ 1, then ratio of kinetic energy of the body at bottom to that at top of the circle is

A coin is placed on a disc. The coefficient of friction between the coin and the disc is μ. If the distance of the coin from the center of the disc is r, the maximum angular velocity which can be given to the disc, so that the coin does not slip away, is :
sol: Friction supplies the centripetal force: mω^{2}r ≤ μmg → ω_{max} = √{\f{μg}{r}}.

pyq.q: A bob of mass m is suspended at a point O by a light string of length l and left to perform vertical motion (circular). Initially, by applying horizontal velocity v_{0} at the lowest point 'A', the string becomes slack when the bob reaches the top point 'D'. B is 60° from A and C is 60° from D (measured at O). The ratio of the kinetic energy of the bob at the points B and C is ____.
sol: Slack exactly at the top → v_{D}^{2} = gl.
Heights above A: B = \f{l}{2}, C = \f{3l}{2}, D = 2l → v_{B}^{2} = gl + 3gl = 4gl, v_{C}^{2} = gl + gl = 2gl → ratio 2.

pyq.q: A bob of mass 'm' is suspended by a light string of length 'L'. It is imparted a minimum horizontal velocity at the lowest point A such that it just completes half circle reaching the top most position B. The ratio of kinetic energies \f{(K.E.)_{A}}{(K.E.)_{B}} is :
sol: Just completing: v_{B}^{2} = gL at the top; v_{A}^{2} = gL + 4gL = 5gL.
